_about: Gizmo Explains: explainer topics in order (docs/GIZMO_RUN.md). `python3 studio/upload_guard.py --next explainer --channel gizmo` takes the first one with no cartoon plan entry. Already on the channel as songs, never as explainers: magnets, day and night, the 5 senses, rainbows, why the sky is blue, sink or float, weather, the planets. When 3 or fewer are left, add five new true, calm topics that repeat no title on the channel. Every fact is read at its source on the day the script is written; the angle here is a pointer, not a fact sheet.

topics.title: How Do Rockets Fly?
topics.angle: push: gas rushes down, the rocket goes up; stages drop away; it works in space too

topics.title: Where Does Rain Come From?
topics.angle: the water cycle: puddle to vapor to cloud to drops (not weather)

topics.title: How Does a Seed Grow Into a Plant?

topics.title: Why Do Things Fall Down?

topics.angle: solid and liquid; warm and cold
